trigger: start of the case / Rule 26(f) conference timing (see 26(a)(1)(C))
applies_to: initial disclosures are owed automatically
notes: Exempt categories in 26(a)(1)(B); court or stipulation can alter. Paraphrase: no discovery request is needed to trigger the duty.

applies_to: initial disclosures
notes: Different time by stipulation or court order; a party may object at the conference that disclosures are inappropriate, state it in the proposed plan, and the court then sets timing.

trigger: being served or joined (when that happens after the 26(f) conference)
applies_to: initial disclosures by a late-served/joined party
notes: Stipulation or court order may set a different time.

applies_to: list of the expert's authored publications in the report
notes: Report requirement itself may be varied by stipulation or court order. Look-back period, not a deadline.

applies_to: list of prior expert testimony cases in the report
notes: Report requirement may be varied by stipulation or court order. Look-back period, not a deadline.

trigger: trial date (or date case is to be ready for trial)
applies_to: expert disclosures (default)
notes: Default only; court orders times and sequence, and stipulation may change it.

trigger: the other party's expert disclosure on the same subject
applies_to: rebuttal-only expert disclosure
notes: Default absent stipulation or court order; applies only where evidence is solely to contradict or rebut.

applies_to: filing of the pretrial disclosures with the court
notes: Paraphrase: filing must be prompt; no number of days. Court may order otherwise (26(a)(3)(B)).

applies_to: pretrial disclosures (witnesses, deposition designations, exhibits)
notes: Court may order otherwise.

trigger: service of the other side's pretrial disclosures
applies_to: objections to deposition designations and exhibit admissibility
notes: Court may set a different time. Unmade objections are waived (except FRE 402/403) absent good cause excuse.

trigger: provision of the expert's written report
applies_to: deposing an expert who must give a report
notes: Sequence limit: deposition may not precede the report.

trigger: notice of a clawback claim of privilege/protection
applies_to: return, sequester or destroy the information; may promptly present it to the court under seal
notes: No number of days; 'promptly'. Producing party must preserve the information until resolved.

applies_to: starting any discovery
notes: Exceptions: cases exempt from initial disclosure, authorization by rules, stipulation, or court order.

trigger: service of summons and complaint on a party
applies_to: early delivery of a Rule 34 request
notes: Early request is treated as served at the first 26(f) conference (26(d)(2)(B)).

applies_to: when an early Rule 34 request counts as served (starts the 34 response clock)
notes: Ties to Rule 34(b)(2)(A) 30-day response time.

trigger: party learns a disclosure or response is materially incomplete or incorrect
applies_to: supplementing or correcting disclosures and discovery responses
notes: Court may also order timing (26(e)(1)(B)). No fixed days.

period: by the time pretrial disclosures are due
trigger: due date of the 26(a)(3) pretrial disclosures
applies_to: additions/changes to expert report info and deposition testimony
notes: Effectively 30 days before trial unless the court sets otherwise.

period: as soon as practicable, and at least 21 days before
trigger: scheduling conference or due date of scheduling order under Rule 16(b)
applies_to: the parties' discovery-planning conference
notes: Not required in cases exempt from initial disclosure or where court orders otherwise; local rule for expedited schedule may shorten (26(f)(4)(A)).

applies_to: written report of the proposed discovery plan
binds: attorneys of record and unrepresented parties
notes: Local rule under 26(f)(4)(B) may shorten, or allow oral report.

period: court may set a period shorter than 21 days
trigger: scheduling conference or scheduling order due date
applies_to: timing of the Rule 26(f) conference
notes: Only if necessary for expedited Rule 16(b) schedule, by local rule.

period: court may set a period shorter than 14 days
applies_to: filing of the written discovery-plan report
notes: Or the court may excuse the written report and allow an oral report at the Rule 16(b) conference.

trigger: omission of signature is called to the signer's attention
applies_to: supplying a missing signature
notes: No number of days. Failing that, the court must strike the paper.

trigger: hearing on the pre-suit petition to perpetuate testimony
applies_to: serving each expected adverse party with petition and notice
notes: Court may order service by publication or otherwise if Rule 4 service cannot be made with reasonable diligence.

period: while appeal is pending or still possible
applies_to: window for seeking leave to depose to perpetuate testimony
binds: party seeking to perpetuate; trial court
notes: Court's permission is discretionary.

trigger: stipulation that would interfere with discovery cutoff, a motion hearing date or trial date
applies_to: extending time for discovery by stipulation
notes: Parties may otherwise stipulate to modify procedures, unless the court orders otherwise.

applies_to: taking an oral deposition early
notes: Leave not needed if parties stipulate, or if notice certifies with facts that deponent will leave the U.S. and be unavailable afterward.

applies_to: written notice of an oral deposition
notes: No fixed days; see Rule 32(a)(5)(A) (14 days short-notice benchmark).

applies_to: notice to deponent and parties of an additional recording method
notes: No number of days.

trigger: service of the Rule 30(b)(6) notice or subpoena
applies_to: good-faith conferral about matters for examination
duration limit of an oral deposition
notes: Stipulation or court order may change; court must allow additional time if needed to fairly examine or if impeded.

period: at any time during the deposition
applies_to: motion to terminate or limit the deposition
notes: Deposition suspended for time needed to get an order if demanded.

period: request before completion; 30 days after notice
trigger: officer's notice that the transcript or recording is available
applies_to: deponent's review and signed statement of changes
notes: Request must come before the deposition is completed; officer notes changes made in the 30-day period (30(e)(2)).

trigger: officer's certification and sealing of the deposition
applies_to: sending the sealed deposition to the attorney who arranged for the transcript
notes: Unless the court orders otherwise.

applies_to: notifying other parties of the filing
taking a deposition on written questions early
notes: Leave not needed if parties stipulate.

trigger: service of the notice and direct questions
applies_to: serving cross-questions
notes: Court may extend or shorten for good cause.

applies_to: serving redirect questions
notes: Court may extend or shorten for good cause.

applies_to: serving recross-questions
notes: Court may extend or shorten for good cause.

trigger: delivery of the questions and notice to the officer
applies_to: taking testimony, preparing and certifying and sending the deposition
notes: Rule 30(e) 30-day review period applies through cross-reference.

applies_to: notifying other parties of the filing

period: less than 14 days' notice; promptly move
applies_to: prompt protective-order motion to avoid use of a short-notice deposition
notes: Protection applies only if motion is still pending when deposition is taken.

applies_to: objection to error or irregularity in the notice (waived if late)
objection to disqualification of the officer
notes: Alternative in 32(d)(2)(B).

trigger: when the basis for disqualification becomes known or with reasonable diligence could have been
applies_to: objection to officer's disqualification
notes: Alternative to making the objection before the deposition begins.

applies_to: objections to manner, form, oath or conduct (waived if not made)
notes: Applies to errors that could have been corrected at the time.

period: time for responsive questions; 7 days for recross
applies_to: objection to form of a written deposition question
notes: Waived if not served in writing within the period.

trigger: when the officer error or irregularity becomes known or with reasonable diligence could have been
applies_to: motion to suppress for officer's handling of the deposition
answering contention interrogatories
notes: Deferral until designated discovery is complete, a pretrial conference, or another time.

applies_to: serving answers and objections
notes: Shorter or longer time by Rule 29 stipulation or court order.

applies_to: stating objection grounds (waived if not timely stated)
notes: Court may excuse for good cause.

applies_to: time specified for inspection

trigger: service of the request; or the first Rule 26(f) conference for an early request under 26(d)(2)
applies_to: written response to a Rule 34 request
notes: Shorter or longer time by Rule 29 stipulation or court order.

period: by the inspection time in the request or another reasonable time stated in the response
trigger: the response stating copies will be produced
applies_to: completing production of copies

trigger: service of the request for admission
applies_to: written answer or objection (otherwise matter is deemed admitted)
notes: Shorter or longer time by Rule 29 stipulation or court order.

trigger: motion on sufficiency of an answer or objection
applies_to: timing of ruling
notes: Until a pretrial conference or a specified time before trial.

trigger: good-faith attempt to get discovery without court action
applies_to: bar on expenses if motion filed too early
notes: Sequence requirement affecting expense award.
